description: This file implements the 'Delete' feature for followers in the application, allowing a user to unfollow (delete a follower relationship with) another user by username. It includes command validation, a request handler that interacts with the database context to remove follow relationships, and returns profile information after unfollowing.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete/unfollow a user by username.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username provided is neither null nor empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete unfollow command by interacting with the database to remove the follower relationship and returning the updated profile.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to find the target user, verify current user, remove follow relationship if exists, and return the profile.
